title: Other Gershwin, and Bernstein's West Side Story
summary: He enjoys Gershwin's piano works and praises West Side Story for breaking song forms.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: What do you think of other Gershwin music, referring to your opinion of Porgy and Bess, what about some of the other Gershwin music?
I think he was a very good writer.
I don't mean the pop music.
I think he was an excellent writer. An American in Paris, you mean?
I think he was very good. I enjoy his work very much.
To leap forward and in exactly the same thing, what do you think of Leonard Bernstein?
I like him, I think he's very good.

I think that his West Side Story was very innovative in terms of songs, in terms of the form of American songs, pop tunes, things that became popular. He didn't hold to the thirty two bars, he didn't hold to the acceptable harmonies.
